name: How long does a wrongful termination case typically take?
description: Wrongful termination cases can take a few months to several years, depending on complexity, negotiations, and court timelines.

mainEntity.name: How long does a wrongful termination case typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wrongful termination case varies significantly depending on its complexity, the willingness of both parties to negotiate, and court schedules. Simple cases might resolve in a few months through settlement, especially if there's clear liability. More complex cases involving extensive discovery or a trial can take one to several years to reach a resolution. Your attorney can provide a more specific timeframe once they've had the opportunity to review the details of your situation.
